market_wrap.text: Nifty rebounded 1.14% to 25,514 and the Sensex added about 990 points in a broad-based rally led by autos (Maruti up 7.6%) and banks, with Nifty Bank closing above 63,000 for the first time; IT was the one weak spot, falling for a third session as TCS and Infosys slipped. Your stocks and ETFs fell 0.4% despite the rally because silver and gold dropped again; mutual-fund NAVs for today come out tonight, so fund values still reflect 17 November (18 November NAVs had not been picked up yet).

reasons.reason: No company news found today. Netweb rose even as Nifty IT fell; it had filed that management would meet a group of investors today, and the stock has been recovering from its 6 November low after a strong September quarter.
No company news found today. The gain came on a strong day for small caps and air-conditioning names (Voltas jumped about 9%), after KRN had slid for several sessions to well below its recent highs.
Moved with the broad market rally (Nifty Metal up about 0.6% by the snapshot's data), recovering part of yesterday's fall when copper hit a five-month low. No company-specific news.
